[10] AR: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ EN: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

folded.id: have believed|in|the lord of the worlds
folded.subject: have believed

spans.text: [47] AR: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

folded.id: he wants|to|drive you out of your land by his magic
folded.subject: He wants
folded.object: drive you out of your land by his magic

spans.text: [35] AR: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ EN: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
[20] AR: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ EN: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
[8] AR: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ EN: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
[39] AR: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ EN: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
[43] AR: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ EN: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

folded.id: my lord|granted|me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers
folded.subject: my Lord
folded.object: me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers

spans.text: Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

folded.id: postpone|him|and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
folded.subject: Postpone
folded.object: and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

spans.text: [36] AR: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ EN: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

folded.id: revelation comes|to|them anew from the most merciful except that they turn away from it
folded.subject: revelation comes
folded.object: them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it

spans.text: [5] AR: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ EN: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
[25] AR: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ EN: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
[34] AR: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ EN: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

folded.id: send down|to|them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled
folded.subject: send down
folded.object: them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled

spans.text: [4] AR: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ EN: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
[31] AR: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ EN: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

folded.id: so they|threw|their ropes and their staffs and said
folded.subject: So they
folded.object: their ropes and their staffs and said

spans.text: [44] AR: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ EN: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
[32] AR: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ EN: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
[38] AR: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ EN: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
[17] AR: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ EN: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
[9] AR: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ EN: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

folded.id: the lord|of|the heavens and earth and that between them
folded.subject: The Lord
folded.object: the heavens and earth and that between them

spans.text: [24] AR: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ EN: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
[28] AR: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ EN: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
[48] AR: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ EN: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
[23] AR: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
[40] AR: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ EN: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

folded.id: the messengers|of|the lord of the worlds
folded.subject: the messengers

spans.text: [16] AR: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,

[44] AR: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ EN: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
[11] AR: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ EN: The people of Pharaoh.
[2] AR: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ EN: These are the verses of the clear Book.
[42] AR: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ EN: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
[45] AR: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ EN: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

[41] AR: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ EN: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

folded.id: will come|to|them the news of that which they used to ridicule
folded.subject: will come
folded.object: them the news of that which they used to ridicule

spans.text: [6] AR: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ EN: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

folded.id: will tighten|and|my tongue will not be fluent
folded.subject: will tighten
folded.object: my tongue will not be fluent

spans.text: [13] AR: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ EN: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
[19] AR: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ EN: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
[28] AR: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ EN: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

folded.id: your lord|and|the lord of your first forefathers
folded.subject: Your Lord
folded.object: the Lord of your first forefathers

spans.text: [26] AR: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ EN: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
